{{Quote|The Star Fortress is the heart of Zakuul's treachery on Alderaan. With it removed, this world might have a chance to rebuild. But the battle station is protected by a powerful shield generator here on the surface. We must eliminate it, first.|Choza Raabat|<ref name="Destroy" />}}
After the end of their [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around [[3636 BBY]], the [[Eternal Empire]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] built a '''shield bunker''' in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to support the [[Alderaan Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] that they placed in geosynchronous orbit above the bunker.<ref name="Resistance" /> Commanded by [[ZK-723S]], an elite [[Skytrooper]], the bunker and its [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] was protected by powerful defensive emplacements, [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], and [[Eternal Empire trooper]]s.<ref name="Destroy" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date2" /> [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]&mdash;leader of an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Zakuul&mdash;rallied the local resistance against the Eternal Empire<ref name="Resistance" /> and organized a bombardment of the bunker, allowing the Outlander and the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Choza Raabat]] to infiltrate and destroy the bunker and thus expose the [[Star Fortress]].<ref name="Destroy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The shield bunker on Alderaan was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a 2015 Digital Expansion.
